summary: Focused iterate pass: suite was green; fixed negative --hops clamp, empty-coverage footer D5 shape, and build_atlas exit-3 docs. Regenerated local gitignored mirrors so install.sh --check passes. No medium+ design gaps vs D1–D9.

findings.issue: Negative --hops bypassed clamp_hops and silently floored in walk() with no stderr note.
findings.fix: clamp_hops floors at 0 and render_tree notes the effective value.

findings.issue: Empty coverage list emitted 'graph @ <sha> · covered', breaking the D5 after-'· '/before-' covered' substring mapping.
findings.fix: Always emit 'graph @ <sha7> · <list> covered' (empty list → blank between · and covered).

findings.issue: build_atlas module docstring omitted exit 3 for ambiguous --tree targets.
Local gitignored .claude/.agents skill mirrors were stale (missing explain-code / atlas_tree); install.sh --check failed in the worktree.
findings.fix: Re-ran skills/install.sh --mode rsync; --check now matches. Mirrors are gitignored so not in the commit.
